name: 49531-ocrimage-3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
architecture: DeepseekOCR2ForCausalLM: bf16 vision-language MoE, ~3.4B params in one 6.8 GB shard; the processor tiles one image into a global view plus 2-6 crops.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=10, 2 warmup requests then 100 measured.
workload: Single-turn image+text OCR chat: one 1024x768 synthetic PNG per request, a four-token instruction, exactly one output token, temperature 0.0. Every request's image is byte-different from every other.
purpose: An OCR service reading single page images with short prompts for ten concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR-2

# The checkpoint ships its own config and processor classes and will not load without this.
trust-remote-code: true

max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85

# Off on purpose: every request pays its own multimodal preprocess and its own prefill.
mm-processor-cache-gb: 0
enable-prefix-caching: false

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Serving this checkpoint on an H100 dies during full cudagraph capture; pinning the
# FlashAttention major version to 2 sidesteps it. Removing it will crash the server.
# ONE LINE, inline JSON: the engine's config reader takes this file line by line and skips
# indented continuations, so the block-mapping form is silently dropped and never reaches
# AsyncEngineArgs.
attention-config: {"flash_attn_version": 2}
